content: Ntya kwo Nyakasane adesire: «Mushimbe amarhegeko munakaz’ijira okushingânîne, bulya obucunguzi bwâni buyiruka n’obushinganyanya bwâni bukola bwâciyêrekana.»
Iragi lyâge omuntu okajira ntyo na mwene-Adamu ocîshwêkera kuli ebyo, olanga olwa-Sabato buzira kuluhemukira analange okuboko kwâge kulek’ijira amabî.
Mwene-ecigolo ocîshwêkirekwo Nyakasane, arhaderhaga, erhi: «Ntâco carhuma arhanyegûla omu lubaga lwâge!» N’enkonè erhaderhaga, erhi: «Kali niehe ncîbêrire murhi mûmu!»
Bulyâla ntyâla kwo Nyakasane adesire, erhi: «Enkonè zilanga ensiku zâni za Sabato, ezishimba obulonza bwâni zinacishwêkera oku ndagâno yâni,
“nazihêra omu nyumpa yâni n’omu byôgo byâni irenge n’izîno bilushire abânarhabana n’abâna-nyere; naziha izîno ly’ensiku n’amango lirhakazâzika”.

“Nabo bene-ebigolo bacîshwêkerakwo Nyakasane, omu kumurhumikira n’omu kuzigira izîno lya Nyakasane, mpu lyo bahinduka bambali, na ngasi boshi bâkaz’ilanga olwa-Sabato buzira kuluhemukira banacîshwêkere oku ndagâno yâni”,
“nâbahêka oku ntondo yâni ntagatîfu nnâbasîmikize omu nyumpa yâni y’okushenga
. Embâgwa zâbo n’enterekêro zâbo zâyankirirwa bwinjà aha luhêrero lwâni, bulya enyumpa yâni yakaz’iderhwa nyumpa amashanja goshi gakâshengeramwo”.
“Kwo adesire ntyâla Nyakasane Nyamubâho, oshûbûza bene-Israheli bâli bashandabîne: Nâshûbûliza abandi haguma na balya bâli bamâshubûka.”»
z’erubala, muyishe mufonfomere! Mwe nsimba z’emuzirhu, muyishe mweshi!
Abalâlîzi bâge babîre mihûrha, boshi boshi barhishi cici; boshi boshi kwo bali nka rhubwa rhuduma rhurhankahash’imoka; rhunakaz’ilôrhera halya rhunagwîshîre, rhusima okuhunira.
Orhwo rhubwa rhugwêrhe omumiro muhubu rhurhanahûga, bo bangere barhankahash’iyumwa cici! Boshi banakaz’ishimba ngasi muguma enjira yâge, ngasi muguma anakalonza obunguke bwâge:
«Yishi, nkola nalêrha amamvu, rhunywe rhunalaluke; n’irhondo kwo na kuguma: gacisigîre manji!»

footnotes.text: 56, 1 Ezi nderho za Nyamuzinda ziyâlîzize obucunguzi bw’amashanja goshi.
56, 9 Ezo nsimba, luli lwîganyo lw’abakulu n’abashombanyi b’Israheli. Abàli bakulire olubaga embere z’olubungo, barhàli bantu nkana.
